findings.summary: Dead `LiveDeals` import — `LiveDeals` is imported from `@/lib/live-catalog` on line 46 but is never used after the homepage rebuild removed the old `<LiveDeals />` call. Remove the named import.

Slide counter breaks at 10+ slides — counter renders `0{index+1} / 0{slides.length}` as a template literal prefix, producing `010 / 010` for slide 10 of 10. Replace with `String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')` / `String(slides.length).padStart(2, '0')`.

Unguarded `images[0]` on products without images — `Product.images` is `string[]` with no minimum-length guarantee. `ProductCard`, `CartLine`, `MiniCart`, `OrderSummary`, and `CompactProduct` read `images[0]` as an `img src` without a fallback. Add `images[0] ?? ''` or a placeholder image. Most exposed path: `MiniCart` immediately after add-to-cart.
